(Currently amended) The method of impeding Leishmaniasis transmission in [[humans or animals]] __dogs__ comprising administering to [[a human or an animal]] __a dog__ a composition comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from __Leishmania donovani__ promastigotes or amastigotes and saponin.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition is in the form of a blocking vaccine.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of manose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lisin, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
